tools.name: quadra_read_hook
tools.description: Read what a Uniswap v4 hook is allowed to do, straight out of its address. v4 keeps a hook's permissions in the low 14 bits of the hook's own address and the pool manager obeys those bits, so this is not a claim the hook makes, it is what the pool will actually do. Tells you WHICH callbacks run, never WHAT they do: a hook with one permission can still take every token in your swap.

address.description: The hook's 20-byte address, 0x and 40 hex digits.

tools.name: quadra_amount
tools.description: Convert between a human amount and exact on-chain base units for a token with a stated number of decimals. Always pass the token's own decimals: USDC has 6, a tokenized share has 8, WETH has 18, and getting the exponent wrong misprices by a factor of ten billion, which reads as a price move rather than as a bug. Refuses instead of rounding when an amount has more decimal places than the token can hold.

value.description: A plain decimal like 12.5 when converting to base units, or an integer like 12500000 when converting back. A string either way, because base units overflow a JSON number.

decimals.description: The token's decimals. Read it from the token, do not assume 18.

to.description: base turns 12.5 into base units; human turns base units back into 12.5.

tools.name: quadra_status
tools.description: What this build can and cannot do right now: which chain it targets, which of its own addresses are set (the fee recipient; no token is deployed), and what is still missing. Ask this before assuming a capability exists. This server holds no key and cannot sign or send anything at all — sending, swapping, bridging and launching happen in the Quadra window, signed in the user's own wallet.

tools.name: quadra_list_tools
tools.description: List the paid tools available upstream on BlueAgent, each with its price and its inputs. Reads the free public catalog. This lists them only: it cannot run one and it spends nothing.

tools.name: quadra_quote_tool
tools.description: Ask what one upstream tool costs, without paying it. Reads the live 402 the server answers with, so the price is the real one rather than a number copied into this repo. Some ids answer without asking for payment; those come back as free, not as a price of zero.

toolId.description: A tool id from quadra_list_tools, for example honeypot.

limits: This server holds no key. It cannot sign, send, swap, or pay.
Upstream tools can be listed and quoted, never run: running one costs USDC and needs a wallet this server does not have.
Nothing here is published. The tool names may still change.
